name: Quizzer course benchmark candidate pilot
pageNumbering: one-based physical PDF pages, not printed slide numbers
splitting: whole instructor/course family; IT3080 development, IT4015 held-out test
claimLimit: Ten lecture PDFs from two course families. Not human-validated. One held-out family cannot support a population-level cluster confidence interval. No model-quality result is included.
annotationLicense: Apache-2.0 applies only to original annotations and code, not source documents.
annotationMethod: Original AI-authored questions and short paraphrased answers based on extracted PDF text. Human review, especially negative-case and alternate-evidence auditing, is outstanding. PDF renders and binary hashes were unavailable during authoring.
